name: LLM Gate Companion
shortDescription: Track private LLM Gate budget and usage with local-only API-key storage.
description: A personal Chromium extension for viewing Simra LLM Gate budget and date-ranged usage analytics. The API key stays in local extension storage and is used only for direct, credential-free requests to the configured Simra dashboard endpoints. This first module provides the validated data boundary; Jalali billing insights, dashboard presentation and OpenRouter recommendations follow in later capability modules.
features: Local API-key configuration without cookie access
Validated date-ranged spend and request analytics
Partial results when an individual dashboard endpoint fails
installInstructions: Load the unpacked extension during development.
Open the extension after the dashboard UI module is available.
Configure a newly rotated Simra LLM Gate API key in the extension UI.
